notes: The loader is now actually visible, and the reason it was not is worth saying plainly: it was being drawn every time, but the panel kept resizing itself underneath it. The loader was sitting in a window changing height around it. The panel…
The word below the mark is Summoning, centred in the panel, and it holds for about four and a half seconds.

The arrival is now in two steps rather than all at once: the loader and its text fade out first, on their own, and only once they are gone does the panel begin growing and the contents fade in. Both are slower - nine tenths of a second…
